name: protobuddy-makers
description: ProtoBuddy full-stack deployment package for EdgeOne Makers (Cloud Functions + static frontend)

scripts.build: npm ci --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix frontend ci --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix frontend run build && rm -rf dist && cp -r frontend/dist dist
scripts.build:local: cd frontend && npm run build && cd .. && rm -rf dist && cp -r frontend/dist dist
